dcterms:description: The Multi-view Stereo Correspondence (MSC) dataset consists of more than 1.5 million grayscale patches, including pairs of matching and non-matching patches extracted from images of the Statue of Liberty, Notredame, and Half Dome (Yosemite). The dataset is used for training and evaluation of image patch matching descriptors.
dcterms:title: Multi-view Stereo Correspondence (MSC) dataset
